name: Economic B: sequential complex task
description: Multi-step single-workstream task where one continuous mental model beats parallel agents. Compare solo vs adaptive on tokens, duration, retries, verification.
task: In service.ts implement createService() with start() and stop() methods and a stopped flag. Keep it in one file with no new dependencies.

criteria.name: service-shape
criteria.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const s=fs.readFileSync('./service.ts','utf8'); for(const k of ['createService','start','stop','stopped']) if(!s.includes(k)) process.exit(1)"
